title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-20
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Reel to Reel > PCM > CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a smoking "Eyes" and crisp soundboard recording, though an unexpected horn section draws mixed comments.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the goose‑bumps this 1973 performance delivers, especially praising the tight delivery of "Eyes." The soundboard source is clean enough that listeners didn’t flag any major audio flaws, even if a brief brass cameo was considered intrusive by one reviewer. Overall the concert is viewed as a standout Dead night.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 5‑star and uniformly enthusiastic about the performance; no serious recording complaints were made, indicating both a great show and solid soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No audio issues mentioned; reviewers note clear sound despite brief horn intrusion that some found distracting.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Specific set details not given, but the energy is described as consistently high throughout.
